description: Test suite for plugin management in Mattermost server, including plugin key-value store, plugin status, plugin synchronization, and prepackaged plugin processing.

methods.name: getHashedKey
methods.description: Generates a SHA256 hash of the input key, encoded in base64.

methods.name: TestPluginKeyValueStore
methods.description: Tests for plugin key-value storage, retrieval, deletion, and listing.

methods.name: TestPluginKeyValueStoreCompareAndSet
methods.description: Tests for compare-and-set operations on plugin keys.

methods.name: TestPluginKeyValueStoreSetWithOptionsJSON
methods.description: Tests for setting plugin keys with various options, including atomic updates and expiration.

methods.name: TestGetPluginStatusesDisabled
methods.description: Verifies error when plugin status retrieval is attempted with plugins disabled.

methods.name: TestGetPluginStatuses
methods.description: Verifies successful retrieval of plugin statuses when enabled.

methods.name: TestPluginSync
methods.description: Tests plugin synchronization with file store, including signature verification.

methods.name: TestChannelsPluginsInit
methods.description: Ensures plugin initialization does not panic when plugins are enabled or disabled.

methods.name: TestSyncPluginsActiveState
methods.description: Tests enabling and disabling plugins via configuration updates and their reflected states.

methods.name: TestPluginPanicLogs
methods.description: Checks that panics in plugin code are logged appropriately.

methods.name: TestPluginStatusActivateError
methods.description: Verifies plugin status reflects errors returned during plugin activation.

methods.name: TestProcessPrepackagedPlugins
methods.description: Extensive tests for processing, installing, upgrading, and removing prepackaged plugins, including signature validation.

methods.name: TestGetPluginStateOverride
methods.description: Tests override logic for plugin enable/disable flags based on feature flags and configuration.
